lead: The full `nv verify` gate can go red on files no session of yours wrote, because another writer edits this tree at the same time.
body: A clean `cargo check --all-targets` minutes earlier and errors in a crate you barely touched are the tell; `git status --short` and `git diff --stat` say whose each change is. Where one file carries both writers' work, write your own hunk to a patch with the Write tool, `git apply --cached --recount` it, and leave that path out of the wrap's `## commit:` list, which stages whole files.
